sub_graphs.title: Cancun Gas: Gas Charging and Depletion
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas charging mechanism and out-of-gas error handling

nodes.label: Gas Available for Execution
nodes.description: EVM has gas_left > 0, execution can proceed

nodes.label: Charge Gas for Operation
nodes.description: Execute charge_gas() to deduct gas cost from evm.gas_left

nodes.label: Check Gas Sufficiency
nodes.description: Verify evm.gas_left >= amount before deduction

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Charged
nodes.description: Gas deducted, evm.gas_left reduced by operation cost

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Insufficient gas, OutOfGasError raised

nodes.label: Raise OutOfGasError
nodes.description: Throw exception to halt execution due to gas exhaustion

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Gas: Memory Expansion Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the quadratic memory gas cost calculation for memory expansion

nodes.label: Current Memory Size
nodes.description: Memory allocated in 32-byte words before operation

nodes.label: Calculate Word Count
nodes.description: Compute ceil32(size_in_bytes) / 32 for word-aligned allocation

nodes.label: Calculate Linear Cost
nodes.description: Compute size_in_words * GAS_MEMORY (3 gas per word)

nodes.label: Calculate Quadratic Cost
nodes.description: Compute size_in_words^2 / 512 for anti-DoS measure

nodes.label: Calculate Extension Cost
nodes.description: Compute incremental cost: new_total - old_total

nodes.label: Memory Extension Cost Computed
nodes.description: ExtendMemory dataclass with cost and expand_by fields

nodes.label: Memory Expanded
nodes.description: Memory allocated to new size, gas charged

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Gas: Blob Gas Pricing (EIP-4844)
sub_graphs.description: Models the blob gas fee market mechanism introduced in Cancun

nodes.label: Parent Block Header Available
nodes.description: Parent block header with excess_blob_gas field available

nodes.label: Calculate Excess Blob Gas
nodes.description: Track blob gas relative to TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (393,216)

nodes.label: Excess Blob Gas Computed
nodes.description: Running total of above-target blob gas usage

nodes.label: Calculate Blob Base Fee
nodes.description: Apply Taylor exponential with BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION (3,338,477)

nodes.label: Blob Base Fee Computed
nodes.description: Minimum blob gas price for this block (>= MIN_BLOB_GASPRICE of 1)

nodes.label: Calculate Total Blob Gas
nodes.description: Compute GAS_PER_BLOB (131,072) * blob_count for transaction

nodes.label: Calculate Blob Data Fee
nodes.description: Multiply total_blob_gas * blob_gas_price for transaction cost

nodes.label: Blob Fee Charged
nodes.description: Blob transaction fee deducted from sender

external_entities.name: Blob Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: User or rollup submitting blob transactions

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Gas: Message Call Gas Allocation
sub_graphs.description: Models gas allocation for CALL, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL operations

nodes.label: Message Call Initiated
nodes.description: CALL/DELEGATECALL/STATICCALL opcode executed

nodes.label: Calculate Max Call Gas
nodes.description: Compute gas - (gas // 64) to reserve 1/64th

nodes.label: Check Value Transfer
nodes.description: If value > 0, add GAS_CALL_VALUE (9,000) and GAS_CALL_STIPEND (2,300)

nodes.label: Check New Account Creation
nodes.description: If target is new account, add GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT (25,000)

nodes.label: Call Gas Computed
nodes.description: MessageCallGas dataclass with cost and sub_call fields

nodes.label: Allocate Sub-Call Gas
nodes.description: Transfer computed gas to child execution context

nodes.label: Sub-Call Executing
nodes.description: Child context executing with allocated gas

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Gas: Storage Access Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models cold/warm storage access patterns and associated gas costs

nodes.label: Storage Access Requested
nodes.description: SLOAD or SSTORE operation initiated

nodes.label: Check Access List
nodes.description: Determine if slot is in transaction access list (warm)

nodes.label: Storage Slot Cold
nodes.description: Slot not in access list, first access this transaction

nodes.label: Storage Slot Warm
nodes.description: Slot already accessed or in access list

nodes.label: Charge Cold SLOAD Cost
nodes.description: Charge GAS_COLD_SLOAD (2,100 gas)

nodes.label: Charge Warm Access Cost
nodes.description: Charge GAS_WARM_ACCESS (100 gas)

nodes.label: Charge Storage Set Cost
nodes.description: Charge GAS_STORAGE_SET (20,000) for 0→non-zero write

nodes.label: Charge Storage Update Cost
nodes.description: Charge GAS_STORAGE_UPDATE (5,000) for value modification

nodes.label: Apply Clear Refund
nodes.description: Add GAS_STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND (4,800) for non-zero→0 write

nodes.label: Storage Access Complete
nodes.description: Storage operation completed, gas charged

ambiguities.text: The interaction between blob gas and regular gas is not fully specified - whether they share limits or are independent.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob gas is entirely separate from execution gas, with its own pricing and limits per EIP-4844. Blob gas only affects blob data, not contract execution.

ambiguities.text: The 'Taylor exponential function' for blob base fee calculation is referenced but implementation details vary.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume fake_exponential function as specified in EIP-4844: (factor * numerator) / denominator with iterative approximation.

ambiguities.text: The exact behavior when excess_blob_gas is at boundary conditions (0, max) is not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume excess_blob_gas defaults to 0 at fork activation and cannot go negative. Upper bound limited by practical blob limits.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot exploit gas calculation rounding errors to execute more computation than paid for.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could enable gas-based DoS attacks where attackers get more computation than the gas they provide.

implicit_assumptions.description: Integer arithmetic for gas calculations does not overflow within the bounds of valid transactions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Overflow could result in incorrect gas charges, potentially free execution or stuck transactions.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes compute blob base fee identically using the same exponential approximation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different fee calculations would cause consensus failures and chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The 63/64 gas reservation rule prevents unbounded call depth attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Deep call stacks could exhaust resources before gas runs out, enabling DoS.
